description: Existing BIWW storefront account the test names, not locked. Qualifies by {portalRole} on the store's portal (active user linked to the store) or by Admin/Super Admin on all stores (PortalId NULL; qa user 102 signs in this way). Optional BIWW role. Never another account. BMP-38.

store.description: Store code the account signs in to (ZnodePortal.StoreCode), e.g. BNJM

portalRole.description: AspNet role the account holds on the store's portal (AspNetRoles.Name, TypeOfRole Commerce Portal), e.g. Web Admin. An Admin or Super Admin on all stores also qualifies

role.description: BIWW User Type in the custom user table (Super Admin, Admin, Sales Rep, Market Coordinator). Left out: any, or no custom row
